edits.old: What no source states is the target read operation by which rwb-case serves the list that rwb-source-data builds, and how the daily extract reaches rwb-reporting once the data lake is removed: Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0335; ASM-0429). The story proves the two operations that exist today and records the choice as an assumption, so a change of operation is one contract edit and one test change.
edits.new: The target read operation by which rwb-case serves the list that rwb-source-data builds is `GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases` and `GET /api/recovery/case/v1/queues/{queueId}/cases` on the rwb-case base, and the daily extract reaches rwb-reporting through the rwb-integration activity `deliverFile` on queue `rwb-integration` with a manifest of fileId, batchId, sha256 and record count, with `rwb.integration.FileDelivered.v1` and `rwb.integration.FileFailed.v1` on `rwb.integration.events.v1` and no data lake path (GAP-0335, resolved at the wave-1 contract review).
